exposure: 4-week nutrition education with taste testing of 12 fruits and vegetables
cohort: Children aged 4-6 years old from a Southeastern US Montessori school participated in the study, with 22 in the intervention group and 29 in the control group.
finding: The nutrition program significantly increased nutrition knowledge and liking of tomatoes in the intervention group compared to the control group, and also increased vegetable intake, though not statistically significant between groups.
